# The plan executes the strategy it was built from

## Rule
Every move of the chosen strategy's reader path is carried by a segment of the
plan, and the plan adds no move of its own.

## Criterion
Code compares the plan's segments with the strategy's moves: every move is carried
at least once, and no segment carries a move the strategy does not have.

## Enforces
The decision-versus-adaptation criterion: adaptation may not change a decision.

## Route
| Finding | Route | Cause | Counter | On exhaustion |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| a move of the reader path is carried by no segment | S-11 → S-08 | plan_check_failed | L_edit | skip_publication |

## Change log
- v1, 2026-09-21: created as an invalid fixture: the route spends the wrong
  counter and ends in the wrong outcome. Numbered in the fixture range rather
  than as `V-P01`, which the shipped register now holds (#296): a fixture
  reusing a shipped id overwrites a real check instead of adding a defective
  one beside it, and so fires rule 7's version half as well as rule 6 — a
  fixture that trips two rules proves neither.
